plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Software Development (BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Software Development Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Software Development (Campus)', last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026 (the workbook Index lists Online as N/A for this program). Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints 'Total Credits, BS Degree: 120', which the map matches exactly (16/13/15/15/15/15/15/16). The catalog curriculum is printed as 75-77 credits; the map exercises 76: Mathematics 10 (CS 2300, plus the map's placements for the catalog's two mathematics choice blocks — MATH 1050 for 'MATH 1050 or MATH 1060' and MATH 1190 for 'MATH 1031, MATH 1040 at 4 credits, or MATH 1190', both blocks carrying their full option lists in this plan's notes), Computer Science and Cybersecurity Common Core 15 (CS 1400/1410/2420, CSCY 1200/2400), Required Core 27 (CS 2450/3000/4350/4800, CSCY 2000/3200, CYBR 2500/2750, plus the Programming Course slot: CS 3150 or CS 3250), and 24 credits of major-elective rows (eight 3-credit slots) exercising the catalog's Major Electives (21 credits) and Software Development Electives (3 credits) blocks together. Per the catalog, all courses and all prerequisite courses must be passed with a C- or better, credits older than 10 years require department chair approval, and completing the first two years also completes the Software Development (AAS) requirements.
